title: Green Gooding
description: Read-only catalog for Green Gooding — NYC peer-to-peer rental marketplace.
summary: Read-only catalog for Green Gooding — NYC peer-to-peer rental marketplace.
offersHint: Read-only catalog for Green Gooding — NYC peer-to-peer rental marketplace. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.greengooding.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Search the Green Gooding rental catalog by text query, optionally filtered by NYC zipcode for distance-sorted results. Returns a list of products with id, slug, name, brand, cheapest price, photo, and distance (when zipcode is provided).

toolsPreview.name: get_product_details
toolsPreview.description: Fetch full product detail by slug: description, specs, photos, pricing tiers, available physical units, and categories.

toolsPreview.name: check_availability
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a product is available for a date range. Returns { available: boolean } plus the echoed dates and product identifiers.

toolsPreview.name: get_quote
toolsPreview.description: Compute a price quote for a rental and return a signed checkout URL the user can click to land in the booking form with dates, delivery option, and coupon pre-filled. The user confirms identity and pays through normal Stripe flow.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List the Green Gooding category tree (root categories plus children).

toolsPreview.name: get_pickup_zones
toolsPreview.description: Return the pickup/delivery options for a product: each option has type (PICKUP|DELIVERY), location (address + lat/lng), price, and (for delivery) the maximum reachable distance in miles.

toolsPreview.name: propose_booking
toolsPreview.description: Re-validate availability + price for a rental and create a Stripe Checkout URL the user (or the agent itself, if it can pay) can complete to book the product end-to-end. No booking is created until the Stripe payment completes. Use get_quote instead when the human needs to confirm identity / enter delivery details on the web app first.
